title: Needu Premaku – Jyothi Raju, Philip Telugu Christian Lyrics
translation: Your love has no boundaries, O Lord.
Your love has no measure, O Lord.
No one can equal Your love, O Jesus.
You are the embodiment of love, worthy of all praise.
It is a love that even parents cannot show.
A love more pure than that of a child.
For the poor, the needy, the widows, and the orphans,
It is a love that relatives and friends cannot provide.
You are the embodiment of love, worthy of all admiration.
A love that took human form for the sake of humanity.
A love that gave its life to bring us to heaven.
For the thieves, the sinners, the cruel, and the murderers,
It is a sweet love that no man can give.
You are the embodiment of love, worthy of all worship.
intro: NEEDU PREMAKU is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Jyothi Raju, sung by Ps. Philip. This song was released on March 21, 2026, through Jyothi Raju YouTube Channel.
